name: meds
description: The current regimen — the latest statement about each medication course, with stopped courses gone. Serve it at a fact-time bound for 'what was I on, on that day'. Version 2 named the types under the health domain (card 147); version 3 gives them the third segment (card 196). A single dose (health.medication.dose) is not a regimen statement and stays out, so the list names the three regimen types and not the prefix health.medication., which would bring in doses, missed doses and compliance.
